fields.acceptance: A unit test of the trailer reader finds Change:, Actor:, Leaf: and Review: in a commit body whose Co-Authored-By sits in a separate final paragraph, and still reads them when all trailers share the final paragraph.
fields.statement: rhiza check and the workflows read Change:, Actor:, Leaf: and Review: trailers from every paragraph of a commit body, so a Leaf: trailer counts when Co-Authored-By sits in a later paragraph.

fields.acceptance: An engine test against a real git repo counts a builder commit with Leaf: in its first paragraph and Co-Authored-By after it as the leaf's attempt, and a leaf fixer's commit the same way; a commit naming another leaf still fails.
fields.statement: A builder's or a leaf fixer's new commit counts for its leaf when its Leaf: trailer names the leaf, even with Co-Authored-By in a separate final paragraph.

fields.acceptance: The guide tests fail when the builder example or the fixer instruction puts Co-Authored-By in a paragraph apart from Change:, Actor:, Leaf: or Review:.
fields.statement: The build and review guides show every trailer, Co-Authored-By included, in one final paragraph: the builder example and the fixer instruction.
